artists.biography: The Mighty Boosh is a British cult comedy duo, starting off as a live show over 8 years ago now, progressing to a radio show & now a successful TV series. The radio series is a 6 part series, which won them the Douglas Adams Award for innovative comedy writing, it has never been awarded again! The series was produced by Danny Wallace & first aired on BBC London Live. The Mighty Boosh stars Julian Barratt as Howard Moon & Noel Fielding as Vince Noir; they play zookeepers in both the radio show & first television series under the scrutiny of bad-tempered Bob Fossil (played by Rich Fulcher). Series 2 has seen them progress to living in a flat in Dalston with a Shaman named Naboo(Mike Fielding)& an 41-year-old ape called Bollo (Dave Brown). In 2006 they have taken the boosh on the road once again to around 75 dates around the UK, mainly to the small venues. See www.themightyboosh.com for more boosh news & updates. The DVD boxset including series 1&2,extras,a short film called 'Sweet' also starring Julian Barratt & Noel Fielding and much more was released November 16th 2006. The Mighty Boosh: The Complete Radio Series is a 2001 audio comedy album written and performed by Julian Barratt, Noel Fielding, and Rich Fulcher, originally broadcast on BBC Radio 4. Though categorized as a non-music release, the album features a distinctive blend of surreal storytelling, absurdist humor, and original musical interludes that became a hallmark of The Mighty Boosh’s creative style. The six-episode series introduces the eccentric characters Howard Moon and Vince Noir, whose bizarre adventures set the foundation for the group’s later television success. The album’s sound design and musical elements are integral to its comedic effect, showcasing Barratt and Fielding’s flair for blending narrative and song.

As the group’s first major release, The Complete Radio Series holds a pivotal place in The Mighty Boosh’s discography, launching their careers and establishing the surreal, genre-defying tone that would define their subsequent work. The series won the Douglas Adams Award for innovative comedy writing, cementing its reputation as a groundbreaking piece of British radio comedy. Released by Demon Records in 2019 as a vinyl box set, the original 2001 recordings remain a cult favorite, praised for their originality and influence on alternative comedy.
